name: opensci-study
description: Read a selected OpenSci Study and save authorized research progress with durable receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Continue a research study across conversations
interface.longDescription: Connect to your own coordinator. Read a selected Study, preserve evidence references and save explicitly authorized progress. Requires Python 3.10+ and an operator-owned local connection file. No account, key, Study or hosted endpoint is bundled.
defaultPrompt: Read my selected OpenSci Study and summarize its open questions.
